metadata.title: Ezéchias — Freelance web & mobile developer
metadata.description: Ezéchias ATOMI, freelance web & mobile developer based in Abomey-Calavi (Benin), trained in artificial intelligence and data. Websites, mobile apps and digital tools for businesses and financial services.

about.title: I'm Ezéchias
about.text: As a freelance developer, I turn my clients' ideas into fast, beautiful and easy-to-use <web>websites</web> and <mobile>mobile apps</mobile>. I hold a bachelor's degree in computer science and telecommunications and have worked at the IT department of BANGE BANK Benin and at Benilab Services. Trained in machine learning, I am specialising in artificial intelligence and data science for financial services in Africa.
about.text2: Outside of code, I enjoy hackathons, fintech and blockchain, research, reading and music. Have a project in mind? <contact>Contact me</contact>.
